title: 1388. Pizza With 3n Slices

examples.explanation: Pick pizza slice of size 4, Alice and Bob will pick slices with size 3 and 5 respectively. Then Pick slices with size 6, finally Alice and Bob will pick slice of size 2 and 1 respectively. Total = 4 + 6.
Pick pizza slice of size 8 in each turn. If you pick slice with size 9 your partners will pick slices of size 8.
